reported.title: Inject pulse is 2000 ms instead of 3000 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 2000 on line 7, but the spec requires a 3000 ms HIGH pulse on D4. The pulse-end check on line 70 uses this constant, so every pulse ends 1000 ms early; measured evidence shows pulses lasting 2000 ms (e.g. "pulse from 831 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 3000 ± 150 ms") across all scenarios. 3 of 3 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 831 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 3000 ± 150 ms. A trigger at 1.20 s came during this pulse, which must not change its length.

judge_input.spec:
- Start button on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); inject indicator on D4.
- Each settled press as short as 40 ms starts a 3000 ms HIGH pulse on D4 within 120 ms.
- Presses during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the start contact with 30 ms of stability.
- Print `go` when a pulse starts, and `inject hb shots=<n>` every 400 ms at all times.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
